post_hoc_descriptive.reading: LH's argmax IS a better decel DECISION at the label level (GT-decel windows forced to a decel class 0.4961 vs native 0.4163; GT-cruise windows forced to decel 0.1288 vs 0.1358; n 639 / 1,856, seed 0), yet the composed plan does not move (MD 0.3912 vs 0.3897, FD 0.1638 vs 0.1503). The label -> plan transfer is leaky both ways: on GT-decel windows whose label is NOT decel the plan still decelerates 0.357 (LHS) / 0.450 (FACTORED), and on GT-cruise windows labelled decel it decelerates 0.577 / 0.456. The windows LH adds to 'decel' are ones the os-only plan already decelerates on more often (base-os 0.763 vs 0.692), so the marginal planner gain is small, and its decel labels on cruise convert to braking more often. => the binding constraint is the progress the forced class implies, not the class (prereg s5's committed branch).
